mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and employment signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through stronger corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and PAYEMS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A supply shock, indicated by a decline in industrial production below 95.0, signals reduced economic output and potential inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO falls below 95.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts indicate strong consumer demand for residential construction, which correlates with higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the CPI index above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment and decrease in unemployment rate signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in retail sales (RSAFS) above 450,000.0 million dollars signals strong consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 450,000.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
